value.rationale: The motivating work numerically diagonalizes and evolves a corner-target \(d=5\) model with \(1024\) ambient states and proposes varying the product dimension and non-homogeneity. The new structural lemma reduces the exact search-active problem to at most \((d+1)^2\) states, with \(21\) states in the homogeneous \(d=5\) case, while retaining the exact Green function and success amplitude. The reduction therefore addresses the central computational object of the source and scales polynomially in \(d\) rather than exponentially in the ambient product dimension.
